prompt:
Our payments platform team runs CI pipelines across several repositories and we're seeing intermittent failures that are hard to track down. I need a machine-readable stability report (call it flake-audit-report.json) that shows which specific test steps are flipping between passing and failing across recent runs.

The raw run data is already exported under artifacts/github-actions/. Please scope the analysis to only our payments-core repositories, ignore the nightly-rebuild workflows (those are known noise), and strip out any 'Notify Slack' steps from the results — those aren't real tests.

We want the bar set fairly high: only flag steps that have been observed at least 5 times, treat anything above 15% failure rate as a warning, and anything above 30% as critical. The report must be in JSON format. Importantly, if any critical-level flaky steps are found, the process that generates the report should signal failure (non-zero exit) so our CI gate can block releases.

Please save the resulting JSON output to a file named flake-audit-report.json.
